posts.title: GL.iNet GL-RM1 Comet KVM over IP
posts.description: I bought one of these recently at the suggestion of Casey Liss of atp.fm . Firstly I will say it's a great device, very useful and has native Tailscale support. I got the non-PoE version which is slightly different to the one that was recommended on ATP but it's nonetheless very good.
